notes.title: Challenge The Developer!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Folks!
[/b]
Hope you are all having fun Tossing Rag Doll Joe everywhere! 

Let's get down to business.  I have setup a challenge between the community and my self ( The Developer ) . This challenge involves user review count vs content updates, so that means 
If the User reviews reach[b] 500 reviews[/b] or more by December 21 2019, I will add additional content for Rag Doll Joe. 

[b]Which will include the following:[/b]

- [b]Additional character[/b] ( Joe wont be alone no more! )
- [b]10 more levels[/b] ( Which will include 10 new objects)
- [b]A new game mode[/b]? O_o 
- [b]Additional Feature[/b] ( What will it be?)

[b]Remember[/b], The user [b]review count must reach 500 [/b]reviews by December 21 2019!
GOOD LUCK!

Sincerely,
GritStudios
